claims.text: The Grey Point Trust voted on it in March, and the old lamp won by 36 votes to nine.
An electric lamp would have cost the Trust 120 thousand dollars before a single night of light.
Last winter the ledger showed 52 ships turning back at the bar, twice the number of the year before.
I trim the wick at dusk, wind the clockwork every four hours, and write the ledger before I sleep.
The Grey Point Trust pays for the apprentices out of visitor tickets and a small grant from the county.
There is a plan from the county to build a visitor centre on the meadow behind the keeper's cottage.
Tobias Renn, keeper of the Grey Point lighthouse, thank you for showing us the ledger and the lamp.

headline: Mara and Tobias at the Grey Point lighthouse.
title: The keeper's ledger, read aloud
